intro: Author built his own eurorack case with a 1U rail after blowing up two store-bought NiftyCases with faulty modules; this page shares schematics for basic 1U utilities he built for it, some hard to find documented elsewhere.

utilities.name: Buffered Multiple
utilities.type_description: No frills unity gain buffers to create multiple copies of a signal
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL074 (U1); resistors 1k x4 (R2-R5), 100k x2 (R1,R6); 5 audio jacks (J1-J5); 1 switched audio jack (J6)

utilities.name: Gain
utilities.type_description: Up to 10x amplification of any signal in a straightforward circuit
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading

utilities.name: 3-Channel Mixer
utilities.type_description: Invaluable for routing multiple audio signals to a single effect or multiple control voltages
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL072 (U1); resistors 1k (R7), 100k x6 (R1-R6); 3x 100k potentiometers (RV1-RV3); 4 audio jacks (J1-J4)

utilities.name: Attenuverter
utilities.type_description: When the pot is at center position, the signal is completely attenuated
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL071 (U1); resistors 1k x2 (R3,R4), 100k x2 (R1,R2); 100k potentiometer (RV1); 3 audio jacks (J1-J3)

utilities.name: Gate-to-Trigger Converter
utilities.type_description: modules that respond better to triggers than to gates
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL072 (U1); 1N4148 diode (D1); LED (D2); 100nf capacitor (C1); resistors 1k (R9), 3.9k (R8), 10k x2 (R5,R7), 100k x5 (R1-R4,R6); 2 audio jacks (J1,J2)

utilities.name: Comparator
utilities.type_description: compares the input signal to the reference voltage, and only let's the input signal through
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: LM393 comparator (U1); resistors 1k (R2), 200k (R1); potentiometers 50k (RV1), 100k (RV2); 2 audio jacks (J1,J2)

utilities.name: Passive Attenuators
utilities.type_description: The absolute simplest utility. It doesn't even require power.
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: 100k potentiometers x2 (RV1,RV2); 4 audio jacks (J1-J4); no power connection

utilities.name: Scale/Offset
utilities.type_description: Scale is used to adjust the amplitude of a voltage signal
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL074 (U1); resistors 1k x2 (R3,R6), 10k x4 (R1,R2,R4,R5); 100k potentiometers x2 (RV1,RV2); 3 audio jacks (J1-J3); includes an inverted output

lineage.credit: stripped down version of the core functionality of Voltage Daikaiju
lineage.quote: This is a stripped down version of the core functionality of Voltage Daikaiju.

utilities.name: 5V On Demand
utilities.type_description: Use it to boost or add positive DC offset to control voltage
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: L78L05 voltage regulator or similar (U1); 100nf capacitor (C1); 10k potentiometers x2 (RV1,RV2); 2 audio jacks (J1,J2)

utilities.name: Glide
utilities.type_description: Standalone glide (aka glissando or portamento) for making those classic Gary Numan sounds
utilities.bom_where: page's own BOM list under this module's heading
utilities.bom_parts_summary: TL072 (U1); 2.2uf electrolytic capacitor (C1); 1k resistor (R1); 500k potentiometer (RV1); 2 audio jacks (J1,J2)

notes: No licence statement appears anywhere on the page. No HP/width is stated for any module except Gain, where the body text says 'I can squeeze one of this in a 10HP 1U module' (read as this module's HP). No module lists a package/mounting type (THT/SMD) anywhere on the page, so components is null for all ten. The page's ten module headings as written are: Buffered Multiple, Gain, 3-Channel Mixer, Attenuverter, Gate-to-Trigger Converter, Comparator, Passive Attenuators, Scale/Offset, 5V On Demand, Glide -- the page does not label any of them '(v2)'; that qualifier appears only in the task's given schematic-image filename list, which this file's schematic_url values follow literally (URL-encoded, unverified by fetching each image). Only Scale/Offset carries a design-lineage statement (to Voltage Daikaiju, an internal Mechlab Industries page). Electric Druid's ENVGEN8 chip is referenced only as a companion device for 5V On Demand's use case ('great for something like Electric Druid's ENVGEN ADSR chip'), not as a part incorporated into any of the ten utilities' own BOMs -- so no utility 'uses' that chip in the sense of it appearing in a BOM. Footer also carries the author's Spotify/SoundCloud/YouTube artist links, unrelated to the modules.
